title: Quad Report profile
description: The owner's company, metric definitions, targets, goals and connections. Lives in the owner's data folder as quad-profile.json, never in the skill folder.

schema_version.description: Profile format version. quad_data.py status says when it is behind.

report_by.description: Name as it appears on the slide

theme.description: Annual theme, if they have one

vision.description: One-line multi-year vision, if they have one

work_month_mapping.description: Where the invoice-to-work-month mapping lives: billing tracker, SOWs, invoice sequence, or none yet

labor_lines.description: Ledger accounts that hold labor, for the reconciliation

platform.description: Harvest, Toggl, a job-costing system, or none

internal_projects.description: Projects that carry no delivery cost against revenue

client_share.description: Rough share of their time on client work, 0 to 1

definition.description: Exactly how it is computed. Never redefined mid-year.

target_basis.description: The definition the target was set on. A KPI is only scored when this matches the definition.

source.description: Where it was lifted from, verbatim

data_tier.description: 0 uploaded P&L, 1 accounting connected, 2 accounting plus time system with cost rates

connections.description: What is connected and on which AI, e.g. {"accounting": "QuickBooks connector", "time": "Harvest export upload"}

ai_platform.description: Where they last ran it: Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot. Informational only.
